question: What outcome follows from daily non-eating in this practice?
premises: Daily non-eating is specified as the means.
A future going beyond or to that death is stated.
inference: Through daily non-eating, one will go beyond death by aging.
uncertainties: gamiṣyate with mṛtyuṃ may mean 'will reach death' or 'will overcome death' depending on context
plain_english: By daily non-eating, one will go beyond death by aging.
